summary: Quiet Taringa residential kerb with homes close on both sides; workable but exposed.
reasons: Homes 11 m away on own side

best_section.where: South kerb of Stanley Terrace, between two driveways opposite the large modern houses

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m away on the south side near 62 m and more across the road at 16-22 m. Nothing secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb, so room to pull in.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked along the kerb in both images, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep in places: max grade 9.2%, about 2.7% mean
Homes within 25 m on both sides
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees give patchy shade from the south side.
